newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Mer Telemanagement plans U.S. offering.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Mer Telemanagement plans U.S. offering.

text.p: Mer Telemanagement Solutions Ltd (MTS), a maker of call-management systems, said on Wednesday that it planned to raise $20 million in an initial public offering in the United States in January.

The offering will be for 38 percent of equity, after dilution for a parallel offering to employees, said Eitan Metuki, deputy managing director of finance at MTS's parent company, C. Mer Industries Ltd.
He said Jeffries & Co. was the leading candidate to serve as underwriter.
MTS, which had revenues of $6.5 million and a net profit of $1.84 million in the first nine months of 1996, makes telephone-call management systems based on proprietary hardware and software.
The company has marketing agreements with leading telecommunications equipment firms, including Philips Electric, L.M. Ericsson, Executone and Israel's Tadiran Ltd.
